result.summary: The food delivery home screen appears well-constructed. Layout, alignment, typography, and imagery are consistent across the header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, restaurant carousels, and bottom navigation. Excluding the permitted horizontal-scroll clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff, no visually broken elements were found. Only a couple of minor observations are noted.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right sits inside a light gray circular button, but the red unread badge slightly overlaps the bell outline rather than sitting cleanly at the corner, making it look marginally misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Offset the badge to the top-right of the bell glyph so it does not overlap the icon strokes.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative overlapping translucent circles on the right side extend toward the text area and have low visual separation from the green background, which reads as a slightly muddy gradient rather than an intentional decoration.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of the decorative shapes or constrain them further right so they read as deliberate design elements.
